## Ordering & B2B Trade Policy
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ):** 1 complete set bundle per design (typically 4 to 6 pieces across standard size ratios).
- **Pricing:** Manufacturer Wholesale Rates (Inquire directly with Syed Ahmer via WhatsApp).
- **Video Shopping:** Live showroom stock viewing available via WhatsApp Video Call (+91 97015 15477).
- **Return & Exchange Policy:** 7-Day B2B replacement for manufacturing defects.
- **Dispatch Time:** Same-day parcel dispatch for orders confirmed before 4:00 PM IST.
